occurrences.exact_quote:
| Relation | What it means | What it does **not** automatically mean |
|---|---|---|
| **Biological father / mother** | A witness-qualified parental relationship | Teacher, ruler, predecessor, or contextual influence |
| **Joint birth event** | Named parental roles participate in the generation of a child | Several alternative predecessors acting simultaneously |
| **Ancestor** | A more remote descent relationship | Exactly one immediate generation |
| **Legal or adoptive affiliation** | Someone is reckoned as a child under a stated act or convention | Their biological descent has changed |
| **Office predecessor** | Someone previously occupied the same functional position | Biological ancestor |
| **Teacher or transmitter** | Someone supplies knowledge, instruction, or a function | Biological parent |
| **Parent-class context** | The parent’s peers, rank, position, and surrounding relationships | Additional parents |
| **Composite ancestral contribution** | A model combines specified ancestors while retaining their identities | A newly invented person |
| **Alternative mathematical predecessor** | One of several states from which an output can be reached | One of several simultaneous biological parents |
